Location: Lambeth

About This Job

Watch this short video to find out more https://capita.wistia.com/medias/2spl0ey4a9

Other benefits
•
HCPC/NMC/GPhC fees paid and full revalidation support.
•
15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
•
Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.

Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.

Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
•
A paid volunteering day each year.
•
Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
•
25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) with the option to buy more up to 5 days.
What you’ll do in this role:
•
Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
•
Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
•
Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
•
Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
•
Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.
What are PIP and WCA?
•
Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
•
Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP/DfC determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

Qualifications
About you
•
Registered Nurse (RGN, RCN, RMN or RNLD), Paramedic, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist, or Pharmacist
•
Full registration with a relevant UK regulatory body (NMC, HCPC,  GPhC or equivalent), with an active PIN and no restrictions.
•
At least one year of broad post-registration clinical experience working with adult patients
•
Excellent observational, questioning and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper
•
Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports from multiple information sources
•
Comfortable and able to work quickly to meet structured targets
•
Good IT skills including experience using clinical IT systems, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn and utilise new systems effectively.
Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Additional Information
About Capita HAAS
We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).
We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.
Security and compliance
Successful candidates will be required to successfully complete government baseline personnel security standard vetting. This is the recognised standard for the pre-employment screening of individuals with access to government asset.
This role is defined as regulated activity relating to children or vulnerable adults within the meaning of the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 it is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. At vetting, you will undergo an enhanced criminality check which will show both spent and unspent convictions.
What happens next?
Please do complete our short application form and upload your CV. (Please ensure there are no unexplained gaps in your CV).
We’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.
As a Disability Confident Leader, we are proud to guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role.
If you have any queries, or want to discuss any reasonable adjustments, please do contact our friendly recruitment team on haasrecruitment@capita.com.

About This Job
Real Estate is the proving ground for our Core Banking Platform. Over 80% of originations already run on Thought Machine Vault Core, and the platform is now where our Real Estate proposition will grow.
This role owns the Real Estate product agenda on that platform. You will define the initiatives that make up the Real Estate roadmap for the Vault Squad and define how our Real Estate products behave on Vault Core to the level of precision an engineer can build from: how interest accrues, how fees are charged, how payments are allocated, how drawdowns work, and what happens at every boundary and edge case in between.
It is a deliberately deep, hands-on product role for someone who is energised rather than daunted by day-count conventions, rounding rules and payment waterfalls.
Roadmap & Initiative Definition
• Define and shape the Real Estate initiatives on the Core Banking Platform roadmap, sequenced against Real Estate’s commercial priorities and the platform’s delivery capacity.
• Run discovery on new Real Estate propositions such as bridging drawdowns and development finance, establishing the underlying customer and business need, the product mechanics it implies, and whether the platform can support it.
• Convert business intent into well-formed initiatives with a clear problem statement, scope, dependencies and definition of success, so the Vault Squad has a credible, prioritised pipeline of work.
• Bring a point of view. Where a business request is poorly formed, unaffordable or better solved elsewhere in the estate, say so early and propose the alternative.
Product Definition on Vault Core
• Own how the Real Estate lending range behaves on Vault Core — interest accrual and capitalisation, interest payment dates and rate-change mechanics, fees, payment allocation and waterfall order, drawdown and repayment behaviour, arrears and forbearance treatment — including product configuration and the rationale behind every parameter choice.
• Translate propositions, facility terms and legal documentation into unambiguous smart contract requirements, with user stories and Gherkin acceptance criteria covering happy path, unhappy path, boundary and invalid-input cases.
• Build worked calculation models that supply the expected numbers behind acceptance criteria, so correctness is demonstrable rather than asserted.
• Decide whether a need is met by configuration, new platform capability, or an operational workaround, and make the trade-off explicit rather than defaulting to build.
• Build in the controls the Bank needs from the outset: FCA and Consumer Duty outcomes, accuracy of customer-facing interest, fee and balance calculations, auditable posting behaviour and correct GL treatment.
• Review implemented behaviour against requirements alongside engineers, and own product sign-off through test and UAT.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work day to day with the engineers on the Vault Squad, not just their leadership, in refinement, in design discussions and in defect triage. The quality of this working relationship is the single biggest determinant of success in the role.
• Partner with the Real Estate business and Operations to understand how products are actually sold and serviced, and bring that reality into product decisions.
• Work with the origination, servicing and payments teams so that product behaviour and the operational capability around it land together rather than separately.
• Engage Finance, Data, and Risk & Compliance early, so accounting treatment, reporting needs and control expectations shape requirements rather than arriving as late constraints.
• Communicate calculation and behaviour decisions in plain language to non-technical stakeholders, and in exacting detail to engineers. Both audiences should recognise the same decision.
• Bring Real Estate’s needs into cross-book design conversations, and flag early where a Real Estate requirement is really a shared platform capability.
Interfaces & Boundaries
• The Vault Platform Product Manager owns the Vault implementation across the Bank and all product lines on it. This role owns Real Estate’s product definition and roadmap within that, and escalates cross-product-line trade-offs rather than resolving them locally.
• The Product Lead, Core Banking Platform owns cross-book demand consolidation, investment business cases and prioritisation. This role supplies the product substance those business cases rest on.
• The Core Banking Delivery Lead and Engineering Manager own delivery sequencing and capacity. This role owns what is being built and why, and whether what was built is right.
Value This Role Will Add
• Gives Real Estate a single accountable owner of product definition on Vault Core, so the squad builds to defined intent rather than reverse-engineering it.
• Turns business ambition into a credible, prioritised Real Estate pipeline, rather than a queue of loosely defined requests.
• Reduces rework and post-release defects by resolving calculation and edge-case ambiguity before build rather than during test.
• Brings new Real Estate propositions such as bridging drawdowns and development finance to market faster through proper discovery and precise definition up front.
• Builds the connective tissue between the Real Estate business, the Vault Squad engineers, and the Finance, Data and Risk functions that depend on how these products behave.
• Creates capacity in the Vault Platform Product Manager role to focus on the platform across all product lines.

Qualifications
Essential
• Product management experience with lending products and their mechanics — interest accrual, day-count conventions, fees, payment allocation and waterfalls — with genuine ownership of how products behave rather than surface-level feature definition, and the confidence to reason about edge cases unprompted.
• Strong core product management craft: discovery, framing the problem before the solution, roadmap definition, and making and defending prioritisation trade-offs with competing stakeholders.
• Experience defining requirements for engineering teams, including acceptance criteria at a level of detail that removes ambiguity.
• Experience with a modern configurable core banking platform, and the ability to interpret how a product is configured well enough to challenge whether it matches intent.
• Comfortable working with API-based, event-driven systems, and able to reason about how components integrate and where data flows between them.
• Uses data to drive decisions, able to model expected outcomes, interrogate system output directly, and ground prioritisation in evidence rather than stakeholder volume.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, and the credibility to work as a peer with engineers and with senior business stakeholders.
• Agile working practices and fluency in Jira and Confluence.

About This Job
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer.
The role is to build a new Forms capability consisting of a Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 backend service and a React / Vite / TanStack frontend portal, both deployed as containers on AWS EKS.
The solution will reuse existing platform services for users, projects, project assignments, document storage/S3, Cognito authentication and SES email, integrating with them through REST APIs and JWT.

About This Job
PhD Interns at TTP use their scientific skillsets to support multi-disciplinary project teams in inventing new products and technologies, utilising commercial acumen to drive projects forward. To succeed in this role, you’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with clients and ultimately work to having a strong understanding of industries we work across.
From a technical perspective, you will be involved in all aspects of technology and product development: from invention, to analysis, to prototype design and transfer to manufacture. The diversity in our work means that you can find yourself making a difference in a wide range of applications as vast as building state-of-the-art drug delivery devices, accelerating drug discovery through AI & next-gen DMTA, or developing a 5G NTN handset antenna.
You will have the opportunity to work on multiple such projects at any one time, so over a year at TTP your experiences and applications will be vast, and you can expect to develop and expand your understanding of entirely new fields of science and technology rapidly.
Equal to your technical work, you will also develop as a consultant. This means harnessing your entrepreneurial mindset: building an understanding of the markets we work in, engaging directly with clients to present your findings, and proactively ensuring their requirements are fully understood and met. As you gain experience, you will have opportunities to work on complex projects, build teams, and help expand TTP’s reach by building connections and engaging with clients.
We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – this is why we have the requirement for all staff to work on-site five days a week. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and trust to take initiative, explore your interests, and shape your own development. You'll be encouraged to contribute early, take ownership of your work, and collaborate across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions.

Qualifications
•
Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking – having achieved a minimum 2:1 in Physics, and currently undertaking your PhD in the subject.
•
Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact.
•
Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen.
•
Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background.
•
Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused.
We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so.
We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance.

Additional Information
TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge. This is a paid internship with generous benefits, including free lunch, as well as a wide range of clubs to join covering sports and social activities.

We will carefully match you to our clients, in your local community, and you will support them to live happy, independent lives by providing:

• Preparation and support with meals
• Prompting and assisting your client with their medication
• Supporting with personal care and to get dressed
• Social visits and support with appointments and shopping trips

As a Care Professional at Home Instead you will receive industry leading training, great rates of pay and 24/7 support from our office team.

• Full or part-time hours available
• All visits are a minimum of an hour
• Paid mileage, 45p per mile & paid car MOT
• Paid training
• Paid shadowing visits
• Ongoing support from Team Leaders
• Regular team meet-ups and social events

Qualifications
Even if you’ve never thought about working in care, you probably have the life experience and skills we’re looking for: kindness, empathy and patience.
If you have a knack for making people smile, then you already have the skills to be a great Care Professional, so no prior experience of care is required. All your paid training will take place at our office in Chichester with our award-winning training team.
*** You will need a driving licence and your own vehicle ***

Additional Information
If you're looking for work which is extremely rewarding and satisfactory and has a high-degree of  flexibility to meet our clients' needs, we would love to hear from you. Please click ‘Apply now’ or alternatively call the office for an informal chat – 01243 884111.

About This Job
Our client in Belfast needs a live in CAREGiver to support her with meals and everyday tasks.  She tends to wake at night and needs someone calm and reassuring to settle her.  She loves her family who are very close to her.  When the weather is good she likes to go out for a drive so a driver with their own car is essential for this assignment.
We are looking for people with kind, compassionate hearts who want to make a true difference to the quality of life for our clients to join our team in Belfast as a Live In CAREGiver. As a Live In CAREGiver, you will live in a client's home and provide a variety of non-medical services to help them keep independent in their own home.
You do not need any experience or particular qualifications to become a CAREGiver. However, it would be useful to have some experience of working in a care setting or interacting with older people for the Live-In role of at least 2 years. This could be personal experience of caring for a family member or voluntary experience. You will have a passion for supporting others and pride yourself on delivering an outstanding service. You will be reliable, trustworthy and respectful. You will enjoy building professional friendships and comfortable in spending time in the company of others.

Qualifications
Qualifications and experience in a health and social care setting are welcomed but they are not essential. However, a good written and spoken English and a real desire to get to know and make a difference to older people in our community are vital.

Additional Information
As a Live In CAREGiver, you will be provided with 3 meals a day or an allowance from the client, a separate room to stay and access to a TV and WiFi.  In addition, we offer comprehensive training and support.
If you're looking for work which is extremely rewarding and satisfactory and have a high-degree of  flexibility to meet our clients' needs, we would love to hear from you. Please contact us on Belfast 02895 609910 noleen.lindsay@homeinstead.co.uk
We encourage applications from all sections of the community as we want to reflect the neighbourhoods in which we work. Home Instead Senior Care is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults and expects all staff to share this commitment. This role is subject to DBS enhanced disclosure.

The King Rufus is a welcoming, family-friendly pub in Chandlers Ford, known for its vibrant atmosphere and fantastic range of pub favourites. From char-grilled skewers and Nashville burgers to hand-battered cod, vegetarian, vegan and non-gluten options, our menu offers plenty of choice for our guests.
With around 40 tables inside and a further 50 outside, our beer garden and outdoor play area make us a popular destination for families, friends and visitors to the local area. We also have a function room, giving guests the perfect space to celebrate special occasions.
As Kitchen Manager / Head Chef, you'll take ownership of the kitchen, leading from the front and ensuring the team delivers consistently great food while keeping the operation organised, efficient and commercially successful.
You'll be responsible for:
•
Leading from the front: Be a hands-on leader who sets the standard, supports the team during busy services and creates a positive kitchen culture.
•
Managing an extensive menu: Maintain excellent food quality, consistency, presentation and portion control across a varied menu, catering to different tastes and dietary requirements.
•
Developing your team: Coach, motivate and support your kitchen colleagues, helping them build their skills and confidence.
•
Running a commercially successful kitchen: Take ownership of stock, ordering, waste, labour and food costs, using figures and reports to make informed decisions.
•
Keeping everything organised: Manage kitchen rotas, preparation and service to ensure the team is ready for busy periods across our indoor and outdoor dining areas.
•
Maintaining high standards: Ensure food safety, allergen management and kitchen compliance are always a priority.
•
Working collaboratively: Build a strong relationship with the General Manager and front-of-house team to deliver a brilliant guest experience and drive food sales.

Qualifications
What we're looking for
We're ideally looking for someone with at least two years' experience as a Kitchen Manager, or equivalent experience leading a busy kitchen. A branded pub or restaurant background would be a real advantage, particularly if you've worked your way up through the kitchen and understand what it takes to build a strong team.
You'll bring:
•
Proven experience managing a busy kitchen and leading a team.
•
A strong work ethic and a hands-on approach to leadership.
•
Experience working with an extensive menu while maintaining quality and consistency.
•
Confidence with kitchen systems, technology and back-of-house administration, including stock management, reporting and financial figures.
•
Good commercial awareness, with the ability to understand costs, manage waste and make decisions that support profitability.
•
Strong organisational skills and the ability to plan ahead for busy services.
•
A passion for developing people and creating a kitchen team that takes pride in its work.
•
A good understanding of food safety, allergens and kitchen compliance.
We're looking for someone who is as comfortable leading a busy service as they are reviewing the numbers behind the operation. You'll be proactive, organised and committed to getting the best out of both your team and the kitchen.

Additional Information
What's in it for you?
At Greene King, we believe in rewarding our teams and helping them build careers they can be proud of.
•
Career development: Training, apprenticeships and opportunities to progress across Greene King.
•
Discounts: 33% off food and drink in our pubs, plus 15% off for friends and family.
•
Greene King Inns: 50% off stays and 25% off for friends and family.
•
Wellbeing support: Access to our Employee Assistance Programme.
•
Family-friendly benefits: Enhanced policies to support you through life's important moments.
•
Recognition: Recommend a friend and earn up to £1,500.
•
Financial wellbeing: Access to Wagestream to help manage your pay.
•
Extra savings: Retail discounts, including Superdrug and Three Mobile.
Greene King is one of the UK's leading pub companies and brewers, with over 220 years of history and a team of around 39,000 people. We're passionate about pouring happiness into lives and becoming the pride of great British hospitality.

If you're an experienced Kitchen Manager who enjoys leading from the front, understands the importance of great food and strong commercial performance, and is ready to take the next step with a busy pub, we'd love to hear from you.
CREATING PLACES WHERE PEOPLE FEEL WELCOME, SAFE AND THAT THEY BELONG

About This Job

The Post Trade Management team are primarily responsible for investigating and resolving post execution payment queries, liaising with our network of Correspondent Banks across multiple regions to ensure such queries are resolved in good time, to uphold our client experience. • Ensure prompt response to and resolution of incoming client queries

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/citycountyhealt.description_excerpt:
About This Job
About Me
I live at home in Kidderminster with my lovely mum and my two brothers. We also have a friendly family dog, who absolutely loves meeting new people—she’ll always want to come and say hello! I have my own cosy downstairs bedroom and a specially adapted shower to support my needs. Our home is warm, welcoming and always full of life. I have transport that takes me to and from school every weekday.
I was adopted at 13 months old. As I grew, my adoptive parents noticed that I often fell over, had limited eye contact, and experienced difficulties with speech, language, listening and attention. In March 2020, genetic testing showed that I have a genetic variant involving STX1B and GABR2. I have epilepsy associated with STX1B, which is also linked to learning difficulties and movement disorders. I was diagnosed with epileptic encephalopathy and experience several different types of seizures, including multiple seizures during the night.
My behaviour is usually at its best when I have one-to-one interaction. I frequently become upset or dysregulated and can display challenging behaviour, often without any clear triggers. I prefer to follow my own agenda and find it very difficult to negotiate or reason with others.
I like watching the same programmes repeatedly and can be very particular at home. For example, I always use my unicorn platter for meals, and my food must be placed in the correct sections. I also need the red stars on my nightlight and the same bedtime music every night. My favourite toy changes from time to time, and when I have one, I will play with it repeatedly for weeks. I become very upset if I can’t find a toy and will ask for it.
I receive support from a number of services, including Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, my Consultant Paediatric Neurologist, an Epilepsy Consultant, and Social Care. Social Care provides 15 hours of after-school support Monday to Friday, as well as respite care with Ruth and at Acorns.
What I Love
I’m a happy and curious child who loves spending time in my garden, visiting animals, and playing with other children. I’m learning how to build friendships both at school and at home, and I really enjoy being around people who like helping me grow and explore. My carers are very important to me, and being able to go to school and spend time with my friends means a lot.
I especially love animals, and my dog Bella is one of my favourites. Sometimes I can play a little too roughly with Bella, so it’s important that I’m always supervised to keep her safe.
Inside my house, I have lots of toys and sensory items to explore! Some of my favourites are:
• My First Aid doctor’s set
• Dolls
• My play kitchen
• Anything sensory — sand, playdoh, bubbles, foam
• Sweeping the leaves in the back garden
I always know exactly what I want to play with, and I love it when someone joins in with me. I often pick a “favourite toy of the day” and play with it again and again — and I’ll definitely let you know if I can’t find it!
Who I’m Looking For
We are looking for a kind, patient, and friendly night carer to support me while I sleep and help keep my nights peaceful and safe. Someone who enjoys being part of a family home, is comfortable around a friendly dog, and feels confident in a calm, nurturing environment would be a great fit.
If you are compassionate, dependable, and hoping to make a positive difference in a little girl’s life, we would love to hear from you.

Qualifications
Experience in the following is desirable for this role:
• Suctioning
• Peg Feeding
• Ventilation
Essential:
• Administration of Medication
• Experience with Challenging Behaviour

Additional Information
Why choose us?
We're an equal opportunities employer. Thanks to the commitment of our health care assistants, we see extraordinary achievements happen every day. We are transforming the care industry by working smarter, using innovative tech and driving forward positive change. As the largest care company in the UK, we have care assistant vacancies across the country, and we offer a world of career opportunity, choice and security.
Apply Today!

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/analysysmason1/.description_excerpt:
About This Job
Join Analysys Mason’s Transaction Support practice at a time of growth and play a senior role in shaping the investment decisions behind technology-intensive markets.
As a Principal, you will lead pre-deal engagements that bring together sector insight, commercial judgement and clear, practical advice in situations where quality, pace and precision matter.
This is an opportunity to take on a senior role in a growing practice within a specialist firm with a strong reputation in digital infrastructure, connectivity, space, media and technology-enabled markets. You will have the scope to build trusted relationships with investors and management teams, contribute to business development, and help shape the continued growth of our transaction support work.
You will work with colleagues who bring deep sector knowledge, analytical rigour and a shared commitment to high-quality advice. We value collaboration, clear thinking and different perspectives, and we create space for people to develop their expertise, support others and build their profile with clients.
For someone who enjoys combining client leadership, team development and commercial contribution, this role offers real breadth. You will have meaningful influence, visible responsibility and the opportunity to do work that supports major investment decisions across the sectors that are shaping the future.
Your responsibilities will include:
• leading pre-deal commercial due diligence and related transaction support engagements for investors and management teams across technology-intensive sectors
• shaping project scope, approach and workplans, and guiding teams to deliver clear, well-evidenced advice under time-sensitive deal conditions
• assessing market dynamics, competitive positioning, growth potential, customer demand, business models and commercial risks
• translating complex analysis into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for senior client stakeholders
• building trusted relationships with private equity, infrastructure investors, corporate clients and management teams
• contributing to business development, including identifying opportunities, developing proposals and supporting senior client conversations
• helping to develop our transaction support offer, including sector perspectives, analytical approaches and reusable tools
• coaching and supporting consultants and managers, creating an inclusive team environment where people can do their best work
• working closely with colleagues across Analysys Mason to bring together relevant expertise from across our specialist areas
• contributing to the continued growth and reputation of the transaction support practice.

Qualifications
We recognise and celebrate the fact that not everybody is the same, and we value the diversity of backgrounds and skillsets you will bring to our team.
You need to have existing experience in strategy consulting, transaction support, commercial due diligence, corporate strategy, investment, or a closely related advisory role. You should bring a strong understanding of technology-intensive sectors, the ability to lead complex client engagements, and the judgement to turn analysis into clear recommendations for investors and management teams.
We are particularly interested in people who enjoy building trusted client relationships, supporting the development of others, and contributing to the growth of a specialist practice. You do not need to have followed one particular career path, but you should be able to show that you can work confidently with senior stakeholders, guide teams through demanding projects, and deliver high-quality advice in time-sensitive situations.

Additional Information
On top of an exciting opportunity, we offer many attractive benefits, including:
• annual bonus
• 25 days of annual leave
• employer pension contribution
• enhanced maternity leave
• enhanced family leave (paternity, adoption, shared, etc)
• private health and dental care
• mental wellbeing app
• flexible working
• your birthday off
• stepped career progression
• continuous training for professional and personal development
• career coaching programmes
• volunteering days
• Cycle-to-Work scheme.
Our values are:
Excellence | We are passionate and aspire to be the industry benchmark.
Partnership | We are one team, and we inspire, motivate and coach each other.
Innovation | We are problem-solvers, and we do not shy away from a challenge.
Integrity | We treat people with dignity and respect.
Empowerment | We motivate, inspire and train our people to be the best they can be.

​You will join our UK Water team as an experienced hydrologist and hydraulic modeller, bringing strong technical expertise and relevant consultancy or industry experience. You will apply your knowledge of hydrology, hydraulic modelling and flood risk assessment across a varied portfolio of projects. Our work ranges from UK infrastructure and development schemes to major international assignments involving climate resilience, water management, mining, hydropower and technical due diligence. Working alongside specialists from across Ramboll, you will contribute to multidisciplinary projects while continuing to develop your technical expertise, project delivery experience and client relationships. You will also have opportunities to contribute to the continued growth and development of our hydrology and flood risk capability.

• ​Undertaking and, as your experience develops, leading hydrological assessments, flood risk studies and hydraulic modelling for infrastructure, water management and climate resilience projects.

• ​Providing clear, technically robust advice to clients and multidisciplinary project teams, translating complex hydrological and modelling outputs into practical project decisions.

• ​Supporting project delivery, technical quality, proposals and client development while sharing knowledge and supporting less experienced colleagues.

• ​A degree, or equivalent professional experience, in hydrology, civil or environmental engineering, geography or another relevant discipline.
• ​Strong relevant professional experience in hydrology, flood risk assessment and/or hydraulic modelling, typically gained over around five years or more in consultancy, industry or a similar environment.
• ​Practical experience of hydrological analysis and established hydraulic modelling software such as TUFLOW, Flood Modeller or HEC-RAS, together with an understanding of current UK flood hydrology methods.

• ​Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and colleagues from different technical disciplines.

• ​Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
• ​A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are

• ​Matched pension contributions
• ​Private medical cover and life assurance
​​
​​Ready to join us?
​Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply. ​
​​Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll
​Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. About This Job
The Insight Analyst combines business analysis of data with the design and delivery of trusted reports and dashboards. The role works with stakeholders to define the decisions they need to make, agree measures and business rules, and turn reliable data into clear reporting and actionable insight.
The role defines the data needed to answer business questions, designs reporting-facing Gold schemas within the organisation’s Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture and gives testable requirements to Data Engineering. Data Engineers build and operate repeatable pipelines and governed datasets. The analyst validates those datasets and turns them into reports and insight, following standards set by the Data Manager and Governance Lead.
This role reports to the Group Data and Governance Manager.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
Understand business needs and measures
• Lead stakeholder workshops and discovery sessions to understand how different parts of the organisation operate and elicit the decisions, questions and measures that reporting must support.
• Agree consistent definitions, filters and business rules for key measures with data owners so teams work from the same information.
• Use prototypes, demonstrations and feedback to refine reporting requirements and acceptance criteria.
Create management information and reporting
• Use governed datasets to build Power BI semantic models, dashboards and management reports, and equivalent outputs in other BI platforms.
• Bring together governed information from different systems and databases to give users a clearer view of business performance.
• Identify repetitive spreadsheets and manual reports that can be replaced with reliable, automated reporting.
• Document reporting logic, data assumptions, refresh behaviour, ownership and limitations; support adoption and appropriate self-service use.
Design reporting data and specify engineering work
• Design reporting-facing Gold schemas and semantic structures in Fabric, defining the grain, dimensions, measures, relationships and business rules required for reporting.
• Specify source data, mappings, transformations, quality checks, refresh needs and acceptance criteria for Data Engineering to build repeatable datasets and pipelines; validate delivery against the specification.
• Work with the technical data team to improve the datasets, structures and processes that underpin business reporting.
Analyse and explain
• Use SQL to investigate datasets, identify trends and exceptions, answer questions and find issues that need further investigation.
• Carry out one-off analysis for projects, investigations and important decisions; test assumptions and provide evidence for recommendations.
• Explain what the numbers show to stakeholders, including uncertainty, limitations and assumptions behind the analysis.
• Suggest ways the organisation can make better use of its data over time.
Support users and assure quality
• Respond to business queries about data and reporting, including definitions, discrepancies, report behaviour and access; resolve within the role’s remit or route to the appropriate owner.
• Reconcile outputs to agreed sources, investigate data quality issues and feed recurring defects or improvements into reporting and engineering backlogs.
• Apply agreed access, privacy, documentation and reporting standards, and raise risks to the Data Manager and Governance Lead.

Qualifications
Knowledge and Skills
• Advanced Power BI skills in semantic modelling, DAX, report design and performance, with SQL proficiency and familiarity with other BI platforms.
• Ability to define measures and business rules and test results against source data.
• Strong stakeholder skills and confidence leading requirements sessions, challenging assumptions and explaining findings to non-technical audiences.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and medallion warehouse and lakehouse architecture, including Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.
• Ability to design Gold layer schemas and write clear, testable requirements for Data Engineering.
Experience
• Extensive hands-on Power BI experience, including dashboards, reports and semantic models.
• Experience leading stakeholder sessions to elicit requirements, agree measures and present insight.
• Experience working with data engineers or platform teams to resolve source and quality issues.
Qualifications
Relevant data, analytics or business information qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Information
Why choose us?

• Leadership. Lead and develop the team leaders for software, hardware, electronics and firmware, robotics and systems integration. Set clear expectations, establish accountability, give direct feedback and build a strong succession plans.
• Drive delivery. Make priorities visible, demand realistic plans, use meaningful measures, surface risk early, resolve blockers and intervene decisively where work is drifting.
• Set engineering standards. Establish and continually improve the practices needed to engineer complex systems well, including architecture, design review, integration, verification and validation, configuration and change control, reliability, maintainability and lifecycle support.
• Protect and evolve the platform. Assure the coherence of the core technology platform and the quality of major technical decisions. Balance immediate customer needs with reuse, modularity, technical debt, product integrity and long-term scale.
• Make the matrix work. Partner with the Head of Product and Application Development to turn product and application priorities into executable platform plans; with Customer Delivery leadership on commitments, sequencing and resource trade-offs; and with Operations leadership on design for manufacture, supply, installation, service and support.
• Represent platform engineering externally. Lead critical technical conversations with customers, partners and suppliers, building confidence through clarity, sound judgement and reliable delivery.
• Build future capability. Work with others to evolve the department to meet the needs of the business, creating talent plans, skill strategy, professional development, knowledge sharing and succession so the department is ready for the next stage of the business.

Qualifications
• Leadership. Proven experience leading a substantial multidisciplinary engineering department through senior managers or discipline leaders, with clear evidence of improving delivery and organisational performance through coaching, setting a high bar, handling performance directly, shaping organisations, hiring well and building skills and succession.
• Relevant system complexity. Experience taking integrated automation, robotics, electromechanical systems or other complex capital equipment from concept through integration, deployment and support.
• Technical breadth and systems judgement. Credibility across software, embedded systems, electronics, hardware, controls, robotics and integration; able to challenge experts and close cross-disciplinary decisions .
• A platform mindset. Experience balancing architecture, modularity, reuse, technical debt and lifecycle needs with the immediate demands of products, applications and customer programmes.
• Engineering rigour. A practical command of quality, safety, design assurance, verification and validation, configuration and change, reliability and continuous improvement.
• Commercial and customer judgement. The ability to balance scope, cost, resources, timescales and technical risk, and to represent engineering credibly with customers, partners and suppliers.
• Clear communication and influence. The ability to create alignment across technical and non-technical groups, explain complex choices simply and build confidence with senior stakeholders.
• Useful context, not a narrow pedigree. Experience in a regulated, safety-critical or high-reliability environment would be valuable. Life sciences or GMP experience is helpful but not essential.
The leadership style we value
You listen widely, then decide. You are direct, fair, calm under pressure and low ego. You stay close enough to delivery to see reality and remove blockers, but you build leaders and systems that do not depend on you for every answer. You are proactive, curious and relentless about follow-through.

What is Amazon Flex?
It's simple! You use your own vehicle and your smartphone to deliver packages locally for Amazon as a way of earning extra money weekly to move you closer to your goals. Schedule a delivery block and start delivering parcels as little or as often as you like.
Who can deliver for Amazon Flex?
To become a Delivery Driver you need a valid UK driving licence and a vehicle. How do I sign up?
Grab your mobile and visit the Amazon Flex website to download the app for iPhone or Android. After the download, the app guides you step-by-step through the onboarding process. Once you have passed your background and criminal record check, you will be able to schedule a block and start delivering smiles!
How long are the blocks?
Blocks vary in length, from 1 to 5 hours, depending on the delivery service you support. For example, 1-hour and 2-hour blocks are available for Prime Now deliveries, where customers receive their deliveries within a few hours of making their order. However, for https://www.amazon.co.uk/ deliveries, the area served is larger. In those cases, it's not feasible to have 1-hour or 2-hour blocks and the available blocks are 4-hour and 5-hour.
Money Matters. Know your earnings.
When you schedule a delivery block, you'll know estimated duration and your total payments all before your delivery block begins. You can build your own schedule, there are delivery blocks available seven days a week. However, the available delivery blocks may fluctuate week-to-week and are not guaranteed.
Adjust your work not your life.
Perhaps you have a job but want to supplement your income. Or maybe you are already a delivery driver and want something to keep you busy on the quieter days. Whatever your situation Amazon Flex can offer you the freedom and flexibility to be your own boss and earn extra cash on your own schedule.

About This Job
Lyst are looking for experienced JavaScript Engineers to join our team in Hoxton Square. We are building a fashion commerce platform that our users love, that brands are excited to partner with, and that we, as engineers, are proud to work on.
The team of engineers and data scientists that work at Lyst are pushing the boundary of how data and technology are used in the fashion commerce space. We are developing an environment and culture that is all about writing great software using the best tools in the best possible manner.
As a JavaScript Engineer you will be ensuring that the platform continues to over exceed shoppers expectations, helping us to constantly release new features and improve functionality. You will work in a product-led cross-discipline team on everything from helping to choose the best tools and frameworks to working with design and product exciting new features.
What you will be working on
• Finding elegant solutions to hard technical problems relating to JS (client side) and/or Python/Django (server-side)
• Contributing to open source libraries that we have either created or use, for example our UI components library Baustein ( https://github.com/ssaw/baustein ) or our CSS inliner that we use for emails ( https://github.com/ssaw/django-inlinify )
• Collaborating with product and designer to build new features
• Building and maintaining internal tools and dashboards, which range from simple server-rendered pages to client side applications built using EmberJS
• Helping to improve our build processes to make deployment and iteration easier and faster
• Writing both unit and integration tests - we love testing.
• Building your own brand and skills. Lyst is a company that will encourage and support you to get involved in the wider community. Events like FOSDEM, JS Conf, LNUG are regular occurrences on our calendar.
• Creating better solutions for everything we do, from culture to the code.

Qualifications
Things that matter to us…
• Progressive enhancement - not because we expect people to disable JS but because we believe this makes you build a better product
• Mobile first - lyst.com is a responsive site and the mobile web experience is hugely important to us both in terms of functionality and performance.
• JavaScript - we favour vanilla JS over a compile-to-JS solution as with ES6 we feel we get all the language level features we need
• CSS - we use LESS (but are considering a move to Sass) and the BEM methodology
• Tooling - our front end build system uses Grunt, Make, RequireJS, Browserify, LESS, JHint, ESLint, Karma, Mocha, Sinon, and a whole load more… but we don’t want tools that get in our way so we are always evaluating this stack.
• Python - yes that’s right, although this role is JavaScript engineer we also do a lot of Python and it turns out JS and Python are best friends
We’re looking for engineers who are excited to join an innovative team to have a real impact on the culture, growth and the code you write. If you enjoy working on fixing real world problems effectively and in the best possible manner. Being challenged and pushing boundries are part of day to day life at Lyst.
We like to build things that solve problems, you will not be constrained by process - we work in small product teams that take a lean approach to building things. We believe that there is no silver bullet to fix the problems and challenges we face: instead we encourage consistent iteration to ensure we are always solving problems. The Senior Environmental Consultant will support the Consultancy Division in providing customers, colleagues, and other stakeholders with commercially aware, technically proficient, and professional environmental risk reduction services.

The role will be a hybrid role,  between home based, onsite and the Risby office, and with close supervision / mentoring by a Principal Consultant and Regional Manager. • Management and planning of site investigations, monitoring, remedial and validation works
• Scheduling and interpretation of field and laboratory data
• Production of interpretive environmental reports including conceptual site models (CSM) and preliminary (PRA) and generic quantitative risk assessments (GQRA)

Compliance

GCSE Maths & English Grade C/4 (or equivalent).

Recognised Train the Trainer/Assessor Qualification (holds or is willing to work towards).

To hold/be assessment as competent in relevant/appropriate Loram UK competence management modules or equivalent.

About This Job
We are seeking a quantitative researcher or quantitative developer to join our Treasury FX Data Science team. You will help build and operate the models and production systems behind FX pricing, risk and trading. Your work will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.
About the Role:
You'll join the Treasury FX Data Science team, helping own the quantitative models and production infrastructure that power how Wise manages FX risk across USD 250bn+ in annual FX volume - serving everyone from retail customers sending money abroad to tier-1 global investment banks via Wise Platform.
The wider Treasury FX team includes quants, traders, analysts, product managers and engineers working together to price, hedge, manage and scale FX operations within Wise in real time. Within that, the Data Science team owns a Python-first, production-grade quant platform which provides multi-instrument pricing, product modelling/monitoring, risk analytics and trading strategies.
We’re hiring for two complementary focus areas:
•
Quantitative Researcher: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative modelling to develop and improve pricing, forecasting, risk analytics and hedging methodology with rigorous backtesting and stakeholder engagement
•
Quantitative Developer: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative engineering to develop and improve production services, shared quant libraries and engineering reliability. You are expected to
Your focus will reflect your strengths, with opportunities to contribute across both areas and broaden your expertise. We expect depth in one area, with a strong shared foundation in Python, quantitative reasoning and production ownership.
What you’ll own
•
A primary focus in either production quantitative engineering or applied quantitative modelling
•
Python implementation of quantitative work from research or prototype through reliable production use
•
Validation, backtesting and monitoring of model and service performance against realised outcomes
•
Deployment, incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement with stakeholders
•
Shared quant libraries used across multiple services
•
CI/CD pipelines, deployments and operational excellence
•
Monitoring, alerting, and reliability for real-time pricing and risk systems
Where you’ll grow
•
Market data management and onboarding new pipelines..
•
Designing new quant infrastructure and systems with the engineering team.
•
Backtesting frameworks, model validation and risk modelling alongside the Risk team (VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis).
•
Customer behaviour modelling, pricing strategy and product development.
•
Collaborating with product teams to translate quantitative insights into customer-facing decisions

Qualifications
What we’re looking for
•
4+ years of relevant quantitative or engineering experience, with strong Python development skills.
•
Quantitative background - maths, physics, engineering or finance - you can read a model and reason about correctness.
•
It’s a bonus if you are familiar with
•
FX or financial markets experience
•
Term structure modelling, stochastic calculus or Monte Carlo methods
•
Interest rate curve bootstrapping
•
Algorithmic execution experience
•
Data lake or warehouse experience (Snowflake, Iceberg, Spark etc.)
•
A product mindset - you think about who uses your systems and why.
•
Clear communicator who can work cross-functionally with other quants, analysts, traders, product managers and engineers.
•
Experience taking quantitative work into production and owning its ongoing validation, monitoring and improvement.
For the Researcher track:
• Strong experience in quantitative research or modelling in finance, with depth in an area such as pricing, forecasting, risk or trading.
• Ability to translate an open-ended financial problem into a quantitative model, choose appropriate statistical or numerical methods, and explain assumptions and limitations.
• Experience designing backtests and out-of-sample validation, accounting for data leakage, transaction costs and changing market conditions.
For the Developer track:
•
Experience with streaming systems, real-time data pipelines, or event-driven architectures (Kafka, Flink, Redis etc.)
•
Experience with testing, monitoring, and debugging complex systems under load
• Strong experience with microservices, databases, and production infrastructure
We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.
Also, qualifications aren’t that important to us. If you’ve got great experience, and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.
And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic

Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About This Job
We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Account-Based Experience (ABX) Manager to own and lead the global ABX strategy, driving the evolution and scale of our ABX program across our global GTM organization.
Building on a foundation of ABX pilots, this role will set the strategic direction, priorities, and roadmap for transforming ABX into a mature, scalable, and measurable go-to-market motion for our Integrity and Assessment product portfolios. The Senior ABX Manager will define and lead the implementation of account-based strategies, plays, processes, and measurement frameworks that drive engagement, pipeline growth, customer expansion, and retention within strategic accounts.
Success in this role requires strategic leadership and the ability to influence and align Sales, SDRs, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and Demand Gen Marketing teams to align around account priorities, orchestrate coordinated account engagement, and deliver meaningful business outcomes. This individual will serve as the organization's ABX subject matter expert, establish best practices and scalable frameworks that strengthen our account-centric approach across mature markets.
Responsibilities:
• Own and drive the global ABX strategy and roadmap. evolving existing workflows into a scalable, repeatable program that supports regional and global growth objectives.
• Define and lead the evolution of account selection methodologies, account planning processes, engagement frameworks, and measurement models.
• Define ABX measurement priorities and success criteria, partnering with Revenue Operations to mature account-level reporting, engagement scoring, attribution, and performance measurement.
• Develop and operationalize ABX plays across key stages of the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, expansion, and retention.
• Lead cross-functional GTM alignment, establishing  scalable processes and governance models that strengthen alignment between Sales, Marketing, SDRs, and Customer Success teams.
• Use account intelligence, market insights, and performance data to identify and prioritize strategic opportunities to improve personalization, orchestration, and account engagement across channels and touchpoints.
• Establish best practices and playbooks that can be replicated across regions and product portfolios, guiding market expansion and program adoption based on business priorities and readiness.
• Shape the ABX technology and data roadmap, evaluating and recommending technologies, data sources, and processes that support the continued evolution of the ABM program.
• Serve as the organization's ABX subject matter expert, influencing senior stakeholders, guiding strategic decisions, and driving organizational adoption and continuous improvement of account-based strategies and methodologies.

Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with at least 4 years focused on Account-Based Marketing (ABM), Account-Based Experience (ABX), strategic demand generation, or field marketing.
• Demonstrated experience owning and leading ABM/X strategy including developing scalable programs, establishing strategic frameworks, and driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact across complex B2B organizations.
• Strong understanding of account segmentation, buying groups, account planning, customer lifecycle marketing, and account engagement strategies.
• Experience developing account-specific and segment-based plays across acquisition, expansion, and retention motions.
• Strong analytical skills with experience measuring account engagement, pipeline influence, opportunity creation, and revenue impact.
• Experience with Salesforce and marketing automation platforms such as Pardot, Salesforce, or similar technologies.
• Familiarity with ABM platforms, intent data providers, enrichment solutions, and account intelligence tools.
• Experience creating executive-level reporting and presenting program performance, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strategic Thinking.
• Builder Mindset.
• Customer and Account-centric thinking.
• Ownership and Accountability.

Additional Information
Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Effectively managing own workload and project managing projects.

Relevant experience in acoustic consultancy

Proven experience in project delivery and managing own workload

Desire to or already working towards CEng

About This Job
The Principle Investigator (PI), at hVIVO is an experienced research physician who provides leadership and direction to the clinical staff during the conduct of a clinical study. A senior role within both the Volunteer Screening Department & Viral Challenge Unit, the PI provides input into the development and management of a clinical study, in addition to carrying out study specific medical duties and screening functions.
Main Responsibilities and Duties:
Promote Good Clinical Practice (GCP) in the conduct of clinical studies by adhering to protocol requirements
Oversee the medical management of subjects at screening, out-patient studies and within the viral challenge unit
Oversee clinic personnel performing study specific tasks and procedures
Provide medical input at all stages of the project lifecycle
Provide leadership, training, mentoring and guidance to clinical staff in all aspects of trial conduct and project orientation so that staff perform their duties in compliance with GCP, local regulations, hVIVO SOPs and guidance
Provide medical input into trial design, protocol and amendment development, subject informed consent, study logistics, and clinical study report preparation
Facilitates a team environment to ensure h VIVO staff demonstrate positive, productive and effective working relationships both internally and externally
Adequately, accurately, and legibly records information into subjects’ source document notes;
Review the accuracy, completeness, legibility and timeliness of case report form (CRF) completion, to ensure that CRFs accurately reflect subject source records, or any discrepancies are explained
Oversee the proper use and storage of the IMP and/or NIMP, including the dispensation and administration of the product to subjects, and product accountability
Build a strong understanding of virology and the medical implications as it relates to conducting studies using the human viral challenge model
Develop and maintains a strong understanding of infectious disease and respiratory illness management as it applies to the conduct of clinical studies within the human viral challenge model.
Key Skills:
• Medical Degere
• Current ALS/ACLS
• GMC Registration
• Fluency in English
• Phlebotomoy & Cannulation skills
• Experience working within the UK health structure
• Post-foundation prescribing experience
• Experience as a study physician within a clinical research environment

About This Job
FluCamp is all about improving the health of the population, through increasing the understanding around common viral illnesses – like the common cold and flu. Ultimately, the more that we understand about how viruses affect the human immune system, the more quickly we can find and test better ways to treat them. The end goal of clinical trials like those we conduct at FluCamp is to potentially eradicate these common illnesses completely – or at least make treatment of them as easy and effective as possible.
Volunteers are central to the work that we do. Our studies focus on testing new treatments on real people, in a safe, controlled, clinical environment.
As a Clinical Support Specialist you will perform clinical assessments and data gathering on subjects applying to take part as well as those participating our clinical trials.
You will provide support to the multidisciplinary team in the planning of daily clinic activities such as panel screening and study specific screening activities in accordance with current regulatory, ICH-GCP standards and requirements. You will also be responsible for sample processing and sample dispatch from external hVIVO clinical trial sites.
Key responsibilities;
•
Screening suitable subjects
•
Perform study specific assessment such as taking vital signs, ECG’s and venepuncture & spirometry
•
Promote volunteer safety and wellbeing
•
Ensure accuracy and credibility of data gathered
•
Sample collection and management
•
Responsible for ensuring temperature monitoring is recorded, reported and maintained in accordance with internal SOP’s
•
Act as the volunteer advocate during the study participation.
•
Assist with the daily management of the clinic
•
Ensure competency in performing their daily task
•
Involvement in the planning the daily clinic activities
•
Liaise with the recruitment officers for the daily schedule of volunteers visit
•
Assist in the supervision and training of new ancillary staff in the screening clinical environment as required.

Start here. Grow here.

About This Job
The BIM & Information Management Coordinator will support the development, implementation and continual improvement of Information Management and Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the Euston and FNICAP projects.
The role is responsible for maintaining project information management systems, supporting Common Data Environment (CDE) compliance, developing reporting and dashboards, coordinating BIM activities, delivering training, and ensuring project documentation remains aligned with ISO 19650 requirements and industry best practice.
The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, document controllers, engineers, suppliers and stakeholders to improve information quality, compliance, reporting and digital delivery performance.
Key Responsibilities
Information Management & CDE Administration
• Create, maintain and continuously improve project BIM and Information Management SharePoint sites.
• Ensure procedures, templates, guidance documents, training materials and useful resources remain current and accessible.
• Support the administration and configuration of project Common Data Environments (CDEs), including REBIM.
• Assist with the implementation and ongoing development of Information Management processes and controls.
• Maintain project information structures, permissions and documentation repositories.
BIM Training & User Support
• Issue, manage and analyse BIM competency and training questionnaires.
• Identify knowledge gaps and develop targeted training programmes.
• Create and deliver BIM and Information Management training, workshops, presentations and user guides.
• Provide ongoing support and guidance to project teams, suppliers and document controllers.
• Capture common queries and convert these into guidance notes, FAQs and training materials.
Reporting, Analytics & Performance Monitoring
• Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to monitor Information Management performance.
• Produce monthly compliance and document health reporting using data from REBIM and other project information sources.
• Analyse key performance indicators relating to:
• Document quality and compliance
• Metadata completeness
• Delivery against programme dates
• Overdue documentation
• Team and supplier performance
• Information Management maturity
• Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Information Management Compliance & Assurance
• Develop and maintain compliance trackers and monitoring tools.
• Conduct regular information assurance and housekeeping checks.
• Monitor project compliance with document control and Information Management procedures.
• Verify:
• Document naming conventions
• Metadata quality
• Revision management
• Status codes
• Approvals and workflows
• Filing structures
• Information delivery requirements
• TIDP and MIDP management
• Record non-compliances, corrective actions and lessons learned.
• Support teams in resolving compliance issues and improving working practices.
BIM Coordination & Model Management
• Maintain project models within OpenTree and associated information repositories.
• Manage superseded model versions and ensure current information is available to project teams.
• Upload, organise and maintain approved model information.
• Support model coordination activities and, where required, undertake or coordinate clash detection processes.
• Monitor clash resolution activities and assist with the management of model coordination issues.
• Develop model performance reporting and dashboards where appropriate.
Information Management Documentation
• Maintain and update core project Information Management documentation including:
• Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
• Information Production Requirements (IPR)
• BIM Execution Plans (BEP)
• Project procedures
• Templates and guidance documents
• Responsibility matrices
• TIDPs and MIDPs
• Support the ongoing review and development of EIR and IPR documentation.
• Ensure project documentation remains aligned with ISO 19650 standards and industry best practice.
• Coordinate updates required following changes to standards, terminology, roles and responsibilities.
Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve BIM and Information Management processes.
• Capture lessons learned, recurring issues and successful practices across projects.
• Develop meaningful KPIs that demonstrate project performance and compliance.
• Support project mobilisation activities through the application of lessons learned.
• Contribute to the development of improved reporting, training, procedures and governance frameworks.
Professional Development
• Maintain and develop technical BIM knowledge and Information Management expertise.
• Undertake ongoing training in BIM and digital engineering software including Revit, Solibri and Navisworks.
• Remain informed of developments in ISO 19650, Information Management standards and industry best practice.

Qualifications
Essential Skills & Experience
• Experience supporting BIM and Information Management activities on complex infrastructure, construction or engineering projects.
• Understanding of ISO 19650 Information Management principles and requirements.
• Experience working within Common Data Environments (CDEs).
• Knowledge of document control processes and information governance.
• Experience developing reports, dashboards and performance metrics using Power BI.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience maintaining BIM and Information Management documentation.
• Ability to deliver training and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across project teams.
Desirable Skills & Experience
• Knowledge of clash detection and model coordination workflows.
• Experience working on rail, defence, infrastructure or major programme environments.
• Experience supporting TIDP and MIDP management.
• Familiarity with digital assurance and compliance auditing processes.

Additional Information
Why Join the Switchers Community?

🔹Provide opportunities to work on exciting, global projects
🔹Access to an employee assistance programme with free mindfulness, health, wellbeing resources and a confidential support line available 24/7 via phone or text
🔹Discount vouchers for days out and restaurants, eye test and glasses vouchers, cycle to work scheme, free flu jabs

We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.
Founded in 2012 by Chris Roberts, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is one of the largest independent game studios in the world – and home to some of the most ambitious vehicle art in the industry. From single seater fighters to capital size ships, our Vehicle Artists help bring the Star Citizen universe to life, working at a level of detail and craftmanship few studios attempt. We’re looking for a Vehicle Artist with hard surface modelling experience to join our team. You’ll work closely with designers, organised into strike teams, to design and build ships of all shapes and sizes – and help craft the flyable, multiplayer-ready levels players will explore.
This role calls for a strong grasp of industrial design and the technical know-how to take a concept from initial model through to a fully functioning ship in the Star Citizen universe – including the software we use and the specific functional areas (cockpits, landing gear, cargo systems, and more) that need to come together. You’ll be working in a collaborative, team-orientated environment, communicating closely with designers and artists across other disciplines throughout development.

What do we expect from our Vehicle Artists?
• Hard surface modelling experience.
• Good working knowledge of 3DS Max and Photoshop.
• An eye for detail while maintaining efficient model making.
• A keen eye for industrial design.
• Avid gamer with a love of sci-fi.
Diversity Statement
CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.
Fraud Statement
We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.

Position Summary
Why join our team?
Samsung's advertising and services business operates across one of the world's largest connected-device ecosystems. This is a role for someone who wants to solve complex product problems at the intersection of privacy, advertising, data and connected-device technology.
Few product roles offer the opportunity to work across all four. You will own an increasingly important product domain for our EMEA business, shaping how consent capabilities develop alongside our advertising, data and measurement products and working with regional and global product, engineering and privacy teams to make it happen.
This is a role for someone who enjoys navigating technical complexity, influencing across global teams and building product capabilities that sit at the foundation of a growing advertising and services business.
We are expanding our Product & Go-To-Market function and looking for a Privacy Product Lead to join our rapidly growing advertising and services business, on an on-going contract basis.
The Privacy Product Lead is the product owner for consent and privacy-related products in EMEA. This role owns the product roadmap, requirements and delivery sequencing for our consent capabilities, including the management and development of existing consent mechanisms.
The role works closely with our data and privacy compliance function to translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear product requirements, and with global product and engineering teams to ensure those requirements are understood, prioritised and delivered.
This is not a privacy or legal role. Privacy owns regulatory interpretation, policy and compliance. This role owns the product: what needs to be built, how it is prioritised and how it gets delivered.
Role and Responsibilities
Your key responsibilities
Consent & Privacy Product Ownership
·        Own the EMEA product roadmap for consent and privacy-related products, including our existing consent mechanisms. Set the strategy and priorities for the domain, define what needs to be built or changed, and maintain clear product ownership through delivery and ongoing operation.
·        Work closely with the Ad Experiences and Data & Measurement Product & GTM teams to understand their requirements and ensure the consent and privacy product roadmap supports the products and capabilities they are developing.
Product Delivery & Technical Readiness
·        Translate the roadmap into clear product requirements and work with global product and engineering teams to get them delivered. Own requirements, acceptance criteria, delivery sequencing and testing, manage technical dependencies and risks, and ensure capabilities are ready for implementation and rollout.
